E4Plus1.uk.description: Pulpit Friction: A trendy new reverend recruits Homer as a deacon. Dry cleaners accidentally swap Marge's wedding dress for one of Krusty's clown costumes. (S24 Ep18/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Fabulous Faker Boy: Bart doesn't want to go to piano lessons, until he meets his beautiful teacher... Homer loses the last two hairs on his head. (S24 Ep20/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Saga of Carl: Homer, Moe, Lenny and Carl win the lottery, but Carl runs off to Iceland with the winnings. (S24 Ep21/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2009) Animated comedy with Bill Hader. When Flint Lockwood invents a machine that turns water into food, he becomes the hero of Swallow Falls. But has he bitten off more than he can chew?

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dangers on a Train: While she's browsing for wedding anniversary cakes, Marge stumbles across a website for married people who want to have affairs. (S24 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Wreck of the Relationship: Homer and Bart take part in a father-son therapy exercise on a ship. While they're away, Marge gets involved in Homer's fantasy football league. (S26 Ep2/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Supercruising: Life at Sea
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the North Africa and Europe voyage, the chefs prepare a fine-dining experience with a difference, while the Caribbean cruisers enjoy tranquil bamboo rafting in the scorching heat. (Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: From This Morning to 8 Days: To the Moon and Back, what do Loyle Carner, Shaun Ryder, Bez, Chris Kamara, Olly Alexander, Oti Mabuse and other famous faces think of our top telly? (S1 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: This time it's Race Across the World, Married at First Sight Australia, The Apprentice, Last One Laughing, Secrets of the Bees, Just One Thing and Celebrity Ex on the Beach. (S27 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers settle in for I'm a Celebrity... South Africa, Britain's Got Talent, The Dog House, The Apprentice, Secret Garden and the news on the Artemis II moon mission. (S27 Ep10) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: TJ, who's been told that he looks like Johnny Depp, turns up for his date after a few daytime drinks. Meanwhile, Ruth wants a man who can keep up with her in her saucy seventies. (S11 Ep7) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Helicopter pilot Paul, who's also a cross-dresser, embarks on his first date in women's clothing. 'Sexy geeks' Hannah and Dan bond over video games and shared insecurities. (S11 Ep8) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: This time it's Race Across the World, Married at First Sight Australia, The Apprentice, Last One Laughing, Secrets of the Bees, Just One Thing and Celebrity Ex on the Beach. (S27 Ep9) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers settle in for I'm a Celebrity... South Africa, Britain's Got Talent, The Dog House, The Apprentice, Secret Garden and the news on the Artemis II moon mission. (S27 Ep10) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Undercover: Peralta enlists Boyle's help to track down a missing mobster, Holt tests the squad's patience with practice drills, and Gina pleads with Boyle to keep a secret. (S2 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Chocolate Milk: Holt's long-time nemesis arrives to carry out an inspection of his precinct. Boyle searches for a plus-one to take to his ex-wife's engagement party. (S2 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Jimmy Jab Games: When the squad have time to kill, Peralta launches the seventh annual Jimmy Jab Games, an eccentric series of contests held in the precinct building. (S2 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Halloween II: Peralta and Holt repeat their Halloween wager, as Peralta bets the Captain that he can steal his watch before midnight. (S2 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mercedes sets out to prove that Jenson's up to no good but stumbles upon something that could ruin Rex's marriage. Frankie and Leah come to blows. Imran investigates the online trolling.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Musical Man: Cameron relishes being interim music director at Luke and Manny's school, but takes on the upcoming spring musical with a little too much zest and passion. (S2 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Someone to Watch Over Lily: Mitchell and Cameron secretly weigh up who in the family could be suitable legal guardians for Lily if anything ever happened to them. (S2 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mother's Day: Claire and Gloria want to spend Mother's Day hiking with the kids, but their bickering and complaining drive Claire mad, and she brings Gloria down with her. (S2 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Good Cop Bad Dog: Phil and Claire swap parenting roles for the day - Claire will be the fun-loving good cop and Phil the disciplinarian bad cop. (S2 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: See You Next Fall: The family gather at Jay's before heading to Alex's middle school graduation ceremony. While they're there, Jay tries to hide a Botox mishap from everyone. (S2 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Good Ones: The eighth and final series. Amy returns from maternity leave and Jake and Rosa work a difficult case. (S8 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Lake House: The squad take Captain Holt up on an offer of a weekend getaway. (S8 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Catfish Cabin: Gordon visits Catfish Cabin in Tennessee, where waning staff morale is causing problems. Can the team overhaul the dark interior and tired menu in just 24 hours? (S2 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Stone's Throw: Gordon Ramsay visits Stone's Throw, a family-owned fine dining restaurant on the Housatonic River in Connecticut, to overhaul the drab interior and revamp the menu. (S2 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bayou on the Vine: Gordon Ramsay visits Bayou on the Vine, a family-run Cajun restaurant in Kansas City, Missouri, where he redecorates with a jazz theme and revamps the menu. (S2 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Boardwalk 11: In Los Angeles, Gordon visits a gastropub and karaoke bar where the late-night singing entertainment has become more appealing than the dining experience. (S2 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart's Birthday: Bart has to organise his own birthday party when Homer forgets to post the invitations. Mr Burns fakes his own death. (S36 Ep1/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Yellow Lotus: The Simpsons stumble across a mystery and an old enemy while they're on holiday at a peculiar island resort. Dr Hibbert drugs an otter. (S36 Ep2/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Desperately Seeking Lisa: Lisa visits Capital City with Patty and Selma, where she's swept up in the city's art scene. But the big city's got an underbelly. (S36 Ep3/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Shoddy Heat: Grampa finds himself embroiled in a cold case when the police unearth an old coffin with his business card in it - and two bodies. (S36 Ep4/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Women in Shorts: The women of Springfield take centre stage, with some special Simpsonified movie parodies including Barbie and The Chronicles of Narnia. (S36 Ep6/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: The Great Australian Bake Off
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Celebration Week: Our eight remaining bakers get the party started with colourful cakes, delicious Christmas creations and glow-in-the-dark spooky goodies! (S7 Ep5/10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Cloudy with a Chance of...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Meatballs 2: (2013) Animated family adventure. An inventor and his friends set out to save the world from a threat that he accidentally created: dangerous creatures made from food.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart-Mangled Banner: The family are arrested after Bart accidentally moons the American flag and Marge says on national television that all of Springfield hates America. (S15 Ep21/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fraudcast News: When Mr Burns is reported dead, all the media outlets say what they really think of him. But the announcement is premature, and Mr Burns takes revenge... (S15 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Inbetweeners Movie
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2011) Outrageous comedy with Simon Bird, Joe Thomas, Blake Harrison and James Buckley. School is over, so the boys celebrate with a scandalous lads' holiday in Crete.
